# HarbourSign

> Uninsured medical document preparation service for family physicians in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador.

## Core Service
- Manual document preparation for un-insured paperwork (insurance forms, employer letters, EI certificates).
- Flat fee: $15 CAD per completed form.
- De-identified intake protocol: Physicians send blank forms and de-identified facts; patient identifiers never leave the clinic.
